source.prompt: Indie dance song, about 3.5 minutes, 118 BPM, E minor. Moody, driving after-midnight mood with a hopeful lift in the chorus. Cool, smooth female lead vocal, slightly detached in the verses and soaring in the chorus, with airy doubled harmonies on the hook. Smooth melodic bass line, soft chorus-washed electric guitar swells, warm analog synth pad, mellow Rhodes chords, legato string line in the choruses. Soft rounded four-on-the-floor kick, gentle claps on 2 and 4, smooth offbeat open hats, soft 16th closed hats. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, warm, wide mix with smooth transients and a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse]
Sodium lights on the overpass
Your jacket hanging off my arm
We missed the last train an hour ago
Nobody's sounding the alarm

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up, the walls are breathing
Every heartbeat's got a meaning

[Chorus]
Dance until the static fades
Till the night gives way to grey
Hold me where the speakers shake
We'll dance until the static fades

[Verse]
Strangers are singing the words we know
Mirrors are shining from the floor
Tell me tomorrow can wait outside
We don't need anything more

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up, the walls are breathing
Every heartbeat's got a meaning

[Chorus]
Dance until the static fades
Till the night gives way to grey
Hold me where the speakers shake
We'll dance until the static fades

[Bridge]
Quiet now, just the hum
Feel the morning, here it comes
Quiet now, don't let go
One more song, take it slow

[Chorus]
Dance until the static fades
Till the night gives way to grey
Hold me where the speakers shake
We'll dance until the static fades
